title: Missing moeb tool: ToolSearch
description: ToolSearch was called multiple times to load deferred moeb tool schemas. No moeb equivalent exists for schema loading. Counts as an external tool call under moeb-tool-origin.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to pre-load moeb tool schemas inline in start_run output or introduce a moeb-native schema discovery mechanism, eliminating ToolSearch dependency.
resolution_summary: Superseded by a1000057: ToolSearch is a legitimate pre-skill bootstrapping tool (no moeb equivalent needed); moeb-tool-origin rubric needs updating to exempt it.
